subject: Procurement kickoff: PO requirements, issuance timeline & line-item guidance
messages:
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>

Subject: Procurement kickoff: PO requirements, issuance timeline & line-item guidance

Hi Sam / Alder procurement team,

Thanks for scheduling the procurement kickoff earlier — looping back with the docs you asked for and a short set of questions so we can align on PO issuance for the pilot. Attached: Redwood_PO_Template_v2.xlsx and our Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf.

Quick asks to help us generate the PO correctly:
- Confirm whether Alder requires a W-9 / tax ID or alternate vendor paperwork for non-US entities (we're Redwood Inc, US).
- Do you require a PO for all purchases or only for orders above a threshold? If there is a threshold please confirm amount and any approver fields we should include.
- Typical lead time from receipt of our requisition to PO issuance (business days).
- Preferred line-item granularity: do you want a single monthly SaaS line (subscription + usage) or separate lines for (a) subscription/seat, (b) token usage/overages, (c) professional services/setup, (d) one-time onboarding fee? Also confirm whether you need GL/account codes per line.
- Remittance/billing address and preferred invoicing cadence (monthly/quarterly).

If it helps, recommended default structure from our side (we can adapt):
1) Redwood Platform - Subscription (monthly) — SKU: RWD-SUB
2) Usage Overage (tokens) — SKU: RWD-USG (billed monthly, metered)
3) One-time Onboarding Fee — SKU: RWD-SETUP
4) Professional Services (hours) — SKU: RWD-PS

Can you confirm by end of week? If Alder prefers a quick call to finalize fields we can do a 20-min sync.

Thanks —
Dev Patel
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182
Redwood Inference

From: Sam Ruiz <sam.ruiz@alderbio.com>

Subject: Re: Procurement kickoff: PO requirements, issuance timeline & line-item guidance

Hi Dev / team,

Thanks for the doc set — helpful. Quick answers below and a few follow-ups:

- Vendor paperwork: Yes, we require a completed W-9 for US entities and a supplier setup questionnaire for international vendors. Our vendor onboarding team will need the W-9 and a bank remit form for ACH.
- PO threshold: We open POs for any purchase >= $5,000. For smaller purchases we can do a credit card or procurement card; for the pilot (anticipated ~$45k) you will need a PO.
- Issuance timeline: Typical turnaround is ~10 business days from receipt of a completed requisition + vendor paperwork. If you provide a completed vendor form up front, we can often accelerate to 5-7 business days.
- Line-item granularity: We prefer separate lines for subscription and any materially priced professional services. Usage/overages can be a single metered line; please include estimated monthly volumes on the line item for our budgeting.
- GL codes: Not strictly required at PO creation for us, but helpful. Our AP team can map items post-issuance; if you have recommended GLs include them as notes.
- Remittance: Remit to Redwood Inc, 123 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94105. Invoicing monthly is preferred.

One additional ask: can you include the expected PO total and an estimated monthly run rate on the requisition? That helps speed approvals.

I'll loop procurement-ops@alderbio.com on the next email with their vendor setup checklist. If we need to hit an accelerated date please let me know target PO issue date.

Best,
Sam Ruiz
Head of Procurement, Alder Biotech
sam.ruiz@alderbio.com

Attachment referenced: Alder_PO_Instructions.pdf (PDF, 52KB)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sam Ruiz <sam.ruiz@alderbio.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 08:13:30 -0800
Subject: Re: Procurement kickoff: PO requirements, issuance timeline & line-item guidance

Hi Sam — thanks for the clarifications. A few internal notes and a suggested PO line-item breakdown that maps to our billing system and should make your AP team's life easier. Quoting your line-item preference above.

Suggested line-item structure (we'll populate SKUs in the attached template):
1) Redwood Platform — Subscription (monthly)
   - Description: Core API access, tier + seat count if applicable.
   - SKU: RWD-SUB
   - Unit: month
   - Estimated monthly: $5,000 (example)
   - Recommended GL: 5000-Software_Subscriptions

2) Usage / Token Overage (metered)
   - Description: Per-token charges beyond included allowance; billed monthly in arrears.
   - SKU: RWD-USG
   - Unit: tokens
   - Estimated monthly: variable — please include a best estimate for budget approvals
   - Recommended GL: 5015-Cloud_Consumption

3) One-time Onboarding / Setup Fee
   - Description: Professional onboarding, integration support (one-time)
   - SKU: RWD-SETUP
   - Unit: each
   - Amount: $12,000 (example)
   - Recommended GL: 5200-Implementation_Services

4) Professional Services (if hourly work is requested)
   - Description: Custom engineering time (T&M)
   - SKU: RWD-PS
   - Unit: hour
   - Rate: $225/hr (example)

Notes / operational requests:
- We'll include an "Estimated monthly run rate" field in the requisition as Sam requested.
- Please confirm billing contact and VAT (if applicable).
- PO number scheme: we typically accept your PO number in the invoice and will match it at payment time. If Alder has a preferred PO number prefix, let us know.

If Alder needs a flattened single-line approach for system constraints we can also provide a combined subscription + est. usage line with a note that usage will be billed as a separate invoice.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if you want to sign this off.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0124

Karthik / Dev — thanks for the suggested structure, that looks good. A couple of final confirmations to keep us on the same page: 

1) PO numbering: Alder uses a PO prefix 'ALD-' followed by the fiscal year and a sequence (e.g., ALD-26-000124). When you submit the requisition please include the placeholder PO number if you have one; otherwise we will issue and share the final PO.

2) Target issuance date: we have an internal close on 24 Feb. If Redwood can provide the completed vendor form + W-9 and estimated monthly run rate by end of day Mon, 16 Feb, we should be able to issue the PO by 24 Feb (10 business days). If Redwood needs an earlier issuance please flag and we'll prioritize.

3) Line descriptions: small ask from our AP team — please move the token unit description from "tokens" to "compute units (tokens)" for clarity on their system. Also add the estimated monthly quantity in the description for usage lines.

4) Billing / remit: confirm ACH instructions on vendor form; we'll validate with procurement-ops after vendor setup is complete.

Once we have the vendor paperwork I'll expect procurement-ops to send the official vendor setup checklist and next steps. Appreciate the quick turnaround — looking forward to the pilot.

Best,
Sam

--
